claims: CarPlay Ultra extends CarPlay's control to all dashboard screens, including the digital gauge cluster.
CarPlay Ultra allows users to adjust air conditioning, temperature, fan speed, seat settings, and driving modes without leaving the CarPlay environment.
CarPlay Ultra takes over the infotainment screen and the digital instrument cluster behind the steering wheel.
CarPlay Ultra features customized gauge cluster layouts that can display navigation, vehicle speed, and music information directly.
Aston Martin is the first to officially support CarPlay Ultra.
CarPlay Ultra is featured on the Aston Martin DBX 707.
CarPlay Ultra is available via update for other Aston Martin models.
CarPlay Ultra is designed to allow users to toggle back to the native car system if needed.
